channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit and more, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Improve perception in robots by building around the optics instead
item.description: When a robot cannot see well, the problem is often the lens and optics rather than the algorithm, and this article explains how data center robots can be designed around optics to improve perception.

item.title: Show HN: Gavel, an open source local code review tool
item.description: Lets a coding agent write a guided tour of your local PR, so you review line by line along its trail and ask questions in a threaded chat right in the code's context.

item.title: Show HN: Pocket Garden – a player interface to over 130 AI based web games
item.description: A mobile-friendly player for 130+ original AI-made web games, with new games arriving almost daily — free and open source.

item.title: Michael Castello Turned a Free Domain into a $3.1M Sale (2014)
item.description: The story of how Michael Castello turned a free domain into a $3.1M sale back in 2014 — a classic domaining tale.

item.title: Vulcan launch of Amazon Leo satellites fails
item.description: ULA's Vulcan rocket failed while launching Amazon's Leo internet satellites — a brief report on the mission.

item.title: Free SSL, cert chain and domain expiry checker with plain-English results
item.description: A free online checker for SSL certificates, certificate chains and domain expiry that explains the results in plain English.

item.title: Vulcan rocket fails during return-to-flight launch, 40 Amazon satellites lost
item.description: ULA's Vulcan rocket failed on its return-to-flight launch, losing all 40 Amazon Leo satellites aboard; the investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Boeing-Lockheed rocket fails mid-flight, destroys payload of Amazon satellites
item.description: A rocket from the Boeing-Lockheed joint venture failed mid-flight after launch, destroying its payload of Amazon internet satellites.

item.title: Show HN: Rbit – Self Hosted Git Forge in Rust
item.description: Self-hosted git forge Rbit, built in Rust with Axum, Gitoxide, and SQLite, is designed around speed, security, and efficiency for anyone wanting to host their own code.

item.title: Thales Launches Sentinel Envelope Plus to Protect from AI-Assisted Hacking
item.description: Thales has launched Sentinel Envelope Plus to protect software against AI-assisted hacking, targeting increasingly automated software attacks.

item.title: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
item.description: A Microsoft 365 outage knocked out a hotel's email warning system during a chlorine leak, leaving 15 guests poisoned and four hospitalized.

item.title: Perplexity partners with Nvidia to launch Portable Computer
item.description: Perplexity and Nvidia have teamed up on a portable computer running a fully local AI agent, with zero token costs.

item.title: Vulcan rocket fails during launch, dealing major blow to SpaceX competitors
item.description: Coverage of the Vulcan rocket's launch failure and what the setback means for ULA and the commercial launch race.

item.title: Agentic AI Designs an Analog Synthesizer
item.description: A project where agentic AI designed an analog synthesizer (TouchSynth) — from circuit design to hardware that makes sound.

item.title: 10 years as a dev. Tried AI coding, got addicted, built a van planner.
item.description: A ten-year developer tried AI coding, got hooked, and built a van-trip planner that sorts routes and campsites.

item.title: I made a tool that turns off Windows 11 telemetry, ads and Copilot, and keeps them off after updates. Free.
item.description: A free little tool that switches off Windows 11 telemetry, ads and Copilot — and keeps them off even after system updates.

item.title: The Backdoor Route That Keeps Beijing in the AI Race
item.description: This report looks at how, under chip restrictions, relevant parties keep access to AI computing power through other routes, useful background for readers following the AI industry.

item.title: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol Status Code 483 (I'm Not a Freezer)
item.description: A tongue-in-cheek IETF draft giving HTTP status code 483 the meaning "I'm Not a Freezer" — programmer humor, filed as a real draft.

item.title: GDC November 2026 survey shows 40% of developers using generative AI
item.description: The latest Game Developers Conference survey finds 40% of developers already using generative AI at work, with more shifts worth noting behind the headline number.

item.title: Catch Go Bugs That Fuzzing Misses with Gemini and a Constraint Solver
item.description: Pairing Gemini with a constraint solver to catch Go bugs that traditional fuzzing misses.
